verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted platform you deploy yourself via pip, Docker or Kubernetes, and it can run entirely offline or air-gapped. That means you control where its data physically lives, and local models via Ollama can keep inference on your own infrastructure too. Missing for 10: no explicit docs on data storage location or residency configuration (e.g. database or storage backend choices), no guidance on residency when routing to cloud model providers, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
